architecture_steps: 1. SHA-1 Content-Addressable Storage: Compute zlib-compressed hash of header + data.
2. Blob Object: Store file content without filename or permissions.
3. Tree Object: Directory listing containing mode, type (blob/tree), SHA-1, and basename.
4. Commit Object: Tree SHA-1, parent commit SHA-1, author, committer, and commit message.
5. Index File: Binary ledger tracking working directory files, modification timestamps, and object hashes.
6. Reference Management: Branch pointers (.git/refs/heads/master) and HEAD symbolic ref.
key_insight: Git is an append-only, content-addressable directed acyclic graph (DAG) of snapshot trees.

architecture_steps: 1. Event-Driven Socket Server: Non-blocking I/O multiplexing with epoll/select/kqueue.
2. RESP (Redis Serialization Protocol) Parser: Handle Simple Strings (+), Errors (-), Integers (:), Bulk Strings ($), Arrays (*).
3. Core Command Engine: GET, SET, DEL, EXPIRE, INCR.
4. Passive & Active TTL Eviction: Check expiry on access + background randomized sample sweep.
5. Append-Only File (AOF): Log mutating commands sequentially to disk with fsync policies.
key_insight: Single-threaded execution eliminates lock contention and simplifies atomic operations.

architecture_steps: 1. Clone with Namespaces: CLONE_NEWPID (process isolation), CLONE_NEWNET (network isolation), CLONE_NEWNS (mount isolation).
2. Root Filesystem Isolation: pivot_root into isolated rootfs (Alpine Linux tarball).
3. Cgroups Resource Limits: Write limits into /sys/fs/cgroup (memory.max, cpu.max) to prevent runaway resource consumption.
4. Veth Network Pairs: Attach virtual ethernet pair between host bridge and container namespace.
key_insight: Containers are simply ordinary Linux processes running under kernel namespaces and cgroup constraints.

architecture_steps: 1. Lexical Analysis: Convert source string into token stream (IDENTIFIER, NUMBER, OPERATOR, KEYWORD).
2. Syntactic Analysis (Parser): Build nested AST nodes matching formal language grammar.
3. Semantic Analysis: Scope resolution, symbol table population, type checking.
4. Bytecode Generation / Evaluation: Stack-based virtual machine (PUSH, ADD, JUMP_IF_FALSE) or direct tree-walk interpreter.
key_insight: Pratt Parsing elegantly solves operator precedence with single-pass binding power.
